name: TAL
comments: Talinolol (Cordanum, Arzneimittelwerk Dresden GmbH, Dresden, Germany) was obtained from commercial sources.

name: RVER
comments: R-Verapamil (dexverapamil hydrochloride) was supplied by Knoll AG (Ludwigshafen, Germany). Solutions of R-verapamil were prepared by the university hospitak pharmacy. This dosage regimen was selected to maintain a high  R-verapamil concentration in the intestinal segment during the major absorption process of talinolol.
